sample_strategy: sample a joint strategy from marginal or joint policy probabilities for a multi-player game
aggregate_policies: aggregate per-player policies into a single callable policy realization-equivalent to the weighted mixture
aggregate_joint_policies: aggregate joint policies into a single callable policy realization-equivalent to the weighted mixture
alpharank_strategy: compute the AlphaRank distribution over strategy profiles for a solver's meta-game
marginal_to_joint: convert a list of per-player marginal policy lists into a list of joint policies
